snippet.title: Nightmare Busters Rebirth - Full trailer - Let's go on Kickstarter!
snippet.description:
BACK NOW on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixnlovegames/nightmare-busters-rebirth-0

Visit our dedicated website: http://www.nightmarebusters-rebirth.com

Nightmare Busters, the lengendary run'n gun from the golden age of 16-bit, is coming to SNES cartridge in a definitive and fully optimized version! 

Tightly linked to the Nightmare Busters Rebirth project in development for Steam, Nintendo Switch, and PlayStation, Nightmare Busters SNES will be part of the upcoming Kickstarter campaign. 

Want to reserve your copy? Join the official Kickstarter page now ➡️  https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixnlovegames/nightmare-busters-rebirth-0
